abstract: Workers Pension Insurance accounts for more than 90% of China’s basic social pension income and expenditure. This scheme is a partially funded design that is pronounced sensitivity to demographic shifts. Persistently low fertility and accelerated population ageing jeopardize the system’s long-term solvency, rendering an actuarial evaluation imperative. Drawing on data from the United Nations’ World Population Prospects 2024 and official Chinese statistical sources, we calibrate an actuarial model to project the system’s sustainability. Our simulations indicate that, absent of a delayed-retirement reform, the pension system is projected to record its first annual cash-flow shortfall in 2033 and to exhaust its cumulative reserves by 2042. Under a phased retirement-age increase, the first cash-flow deficit and reserve depletion are deferred to 2049 and 2058, respectively. By 2100, the system is still expected to accumulate an unfunded deficit of approximately CNY 1715 trillion. Consequently, while the delayed retirement policy may provide temporary relief for pension payment pressures, it fails to resolve the underlying long-term viability of the pension system.
abstract_zh: 职工养老保险占中国基本社会养老保险收支的90%以上。该制度采用部分积累制设计，对人口结构变化高度敏感。持续的低生育率和加速的人口老龄化正危及该体系的长期偿付能力，因此进行精算评估势在必行。基于联合国《世界人口展望2024》及中国官方统计数据，我们校准了一个精算模型以预测该体系的可持续性。模拟结果显示，若不实施延迟退休改革，养老金体系预计将在2033年首次出现年度现金流缺口，并于2042年耗尽累计储备。若采取渐进式延迟退休年龄方案，首次现金流赤字和储备耗尽将分别推迟至2049年和2058年。到2100年，该体系预计仍将积累约1715万亿元人民币的无资金准备赤字。因此，延迟退休政策虽能暂时缓解养老金支付压力，但无法从根本上解决养老金体系的长期可持续性问题。

title: Forecasting the sustainability of workers pension systems in China: a comparative analysis of pre- and post-delay retirement policies
title_zh: 预测中国职工养老金体系的可持续性：延迟退休政策实施前后的比较分析

abstract: The rapid expansion of global tourism has underscored the critical need for accurate regional tourism revenue (TR) forecasting to support sustainable economic development. This study takes Shaanxi Province, a major tourism destination in China, as a case to analyse TR trends and predict future changes. We develop a Quantile Neural Network (QNN) model, optimized through grid search and ten-fold cross-validation, which demonstrates superior predictive accuracy compared to benchmark models. To quantify prediction uncertainty, we propose the QNN-Bootstrap algorithm that combines QNN with resampling to construct confidence intervals, enhancing forecast reliability. Furthermore, the model’s generalizability is validated using tourism data from Beijing, confirming its robust performance in diverse regional contexts. To assess potential risks, this study also simulates TR dynamics under external shocks such as economic crises, pandemics, and natural disasters, and discusses the recovery trajectory following the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings provide valuable insights and policy recommendations to support evidence-based decision-making and promote resilient and sustainable tourism development.
abstract_zh: 全球旅游业的快速扩张凸显了准确预测区域旅游收入（TR）以支持可持续经济发展的关键需求。本研究以中国主要旅游目的地陕西省为案例，分析旅游收入趋势并预测未来变化。我们构建了分位数神经网络（QNN）模型，通过网格搜索和十折交叉验证进行优化，相较于基准模型展现出更优的预测精度。为量化预测不确定性，我们提出QNN-Bootstrap算法，将QNN与重抽样方法相结合以构建置信区间，从而增强预测可靠性。此外，利用北京市旅游数据验证了模型的泛化能力，证实其在不同区域情境下的稳健表现。为评估潜在风险，本研究还模拟了经济危机、疫情及自然灾害等外部冲击下的旅游收入动态，并探讨了新冠疫情后的恢复轨迹。研究结果为循证决策提供了有价值的见解与政策建议，有助于推动韧性且可持续的旅游业发展。
authors: Qi Yang Yuzhu Tian Yijing Zhang Yue Wang a School of Mathematics and Statistics

title: Modelling and forecasting tourism revenue with quantile neural networks: an empirical study from China
title_zh: 基于分位数神经网络的旅游收入建模与预测：来自中国的实证研究

abstract: We propose a semiparametric Bayesian estimator for copula density, formulated as a generalized exponential family that combines a parametric baseline copula with a flexible adjustment modeled by a Gaussian Process (GP). The baseline captures the main features of dependence and accommodates possibly unbounded densities, while the GP component introduces nonparametric refinement. To modulate the influence of the baseline, we further introduce a tuning parameter that adjusts its weight in the final estimate. Both the GP hyperparameters and this tuning parameter are inferred jointly within a Bayesian framework. We also present a posterior sampler based on importance sampling, with the baseline copula serving as a natural approximating distribution. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed estimator and the efficiency of the sampler. The method is further illustrated with an application to commodity futures markets.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于连接函数密度的半参数贝叶斯估计器，其形式化为广义指数族，结合了参数基线连接函数与由高斯过程（GP）建模的灵活调整项。基线部分捕捉依赖关系的主要特征，并能适应可能无界的密度，而GP成分则引入非参数细化。为了调节基线的影响，我们进一步引入一个调谐参数，以调整其在最终估计中的权重。GP超参数与该调谐参数均在贝叶斯框架内联合推断。我们还提出了一种基于重要性抽样的后验采样器，以基线连接函数作为自然的近似分布。模拟实验证明了所提估计器的有效性及采样器的效率。该方法进一步应用于商品期货市场的实例中加以说明。
title: A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
title_zh: copula密度的半参数贝叶斯估计量
